description: Additive normalization corrections for the August 2026 supplier intake. Corrects two entries where the P1B conservative automated reconciliation missed an existing Maison match due to article-stripping and brand-prefix normalization gaps. The immutable P1B normalized intake file is NOT modified — these corrections are append-only governance evidence.

governance.approvalEvidence: EP-CAT-P2C conservative disposition freeze report; Founder authorization 2026-08-15
governancePrinciples: These corrections are additive only. They do not modify the P1B normalized intake.
Corrections contain HIGH confidence entries only — REPOSITORY_CONFIRMED minimum.
Each correction restores a missed NORMALIZED_CONFIRMED match that the automated normalizer failed to produce.
No fuzzy matching or assumption-based corrections are included.
Quarantined entries from EP-CAT-P2C are explicitly excluded from this artifact.

p2cOperationalCounts.note: These counts reflect EP-CAT-P2C conservative governance. Catalogue-wide alias and variant deduplication has not yet occurred. EXACT_UNIQUE_SUPPLIER_IDENTITIES and EXACT_UNIQUE_NEW_CANDIDATE_IDENTITIES are NOT stated here — they are EP-CAT-P3 outputs.

corrections.notes: Standard article stripping of 'the' produces 'azzaro most wanted' which matches 'azzaro-most-wanted-inspired' exactly. The P1B normalizer did not apply article stripping to this entry. Slug confirmed in MKC at app/lib/mkc/native/azzaro-most-wanted-inspired.ts.

corrections.normalizationRule: brand-prefix-strip (Dolce & Gabbana — absent from BRAND_NORMALIZATIONS dict)
corrections.notes: The P1B normalizer BRAND_NORMALIZATIONS dict did not include 'Dolce & Gabbana' as a strippable brand prefix. Manually stripping the prefix yields 'Devotion' which matches 'devotion-inspired' exactly. The product is unambiguously Dolce & Gabbana Devotion (2021). No competing 'Devotion' product exists in the MKC. Slug confirmed at app/lib/mkc/native/devotion-inspired.ts.

corrections.normalizationRule: supplier-shorthand-resolution (supplier abbreviated 'Le Male Elixir' as 'Jean Paul Gaultier Elixir', substituting brand name for product line name — not resolvable by automated normalizer rules)
corrections.notes: Founder clarification confirmed 2026-08-15 (EP-CAT-P3A close-out): supplier label 'Jean Paul Gaultier Elixir' refers to Le Male Elixir by Jean Paul Gaultier. The automated P1B normalizer assigned NEW_SUPPLIER_CANDIDATE (LOW confidence) because the supplier text contains no 'Le Male' substring. MKC slug le-male-elixir-inspired confirmed at app/lib/mkc/native/le-male-elixir-inspired.ts. This entry is a normalization miss — not a new identity. No MKC product is created.
